tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page ground: warm paper white in light, soft black in dark. No colour ever sits behind components; use .lu-wall (bg with a fine dot grid) where a section wants texture.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Solid (non-glass) content cards: reading blocks, case-study bodies.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Nested solid blocks inside a surface card: callouts, code, stat rows. The warm grey is the signature neutral.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface, surface-raised and every glass fill. Also the primary button fill: ink is the brand colour.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text (meta, captions, descriptions) on bg, surface, surface-raised and glass-fill-strong. At least 4.8:1 in both themes.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Dividers and the 1px outline of solid cards. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Clear glass: nav capsule, chips and controls floating over real content (screenshots, drawings, text scrolling under the nav).

tokens.name: glass-fill-strong
tokens.usage: Regular glass: panels that carry text (captions, sheets, hero slab). Use this whenever ink-secondary sits on glass.

tokens.name: glass-stroke
tokens.usage: 1px rim on every glass element; the lit edge of the lens.

tokens.name: glass-specular
tokens.usage: The fixed sheen across the top of glass and the bright top-left of the refraction rim.

tokens.name: glass-shade
tokens.usage: Bottom-right of the refraction rim, giving the lens thickness.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The action colour, which is ink: primary buttons, the nav lens, card arrows, the email tile and the focus ring. Black on paper in light, white on black in dark.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Selected chips and quiet-button hover: a warm grey wash. Text on it stays ink.

tokens.name: control-off
tokens.usage: Switch track when off.

tokens.name: fill-muted
tokens.usage: Muted blocks: image placeholders while art loads, skeletons, the cover's quiet blocks. Never behind text that needs contrast.

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: The dot grid of .lu-wall canvases: the only texture in the kit, monochrome, for heroes and demo grounds.

tokens.name: tag-gray
tokens.usage: Soft label background for chips and project tags (gray). Text on it is always ink; use a tag colour to group, never to signal state.

tokens.name: tag-brown
tokens.usage: Soft label background for chips and project tags (brown). Text on it is always ink; use a tag colour to group, never to signal state.

tokens.name: tag-orange
tokens.usage: Soft label background for chips and project tags (orange). Text on it is always ink; use a tag colour to group, never to signal state.

tokens.name: tag-yellow
tokens.usage: Soft label background for chips and project tags (yellow). Text on it is always ink; use a tag colour to group, never to signal state.

tokens.name: tag-green
tokens.usage: Soft label background for chips and project tags (green). Text on it is always ink; use a tag colour to group, never to signal state.

tokens.name: tag-blue
tokens.usage: Soft label background for chips and project tags (blue). Text on it is always ink; use a tag colour to group, never to signal state.

tokens.name: tag-purple
tokens.usage: Soft label background for chips and project tags (purple). Text on it is always ink; use a tag colour to group, never to signal state.

tokens.name: tag-pink
tokens.usage: Soft label background for chips and project tags (pink). Text on it is always ink; use a tag colour to group, never to signal state.

tokens.name: tag-red
tokens.usage: Soft label background for chips and project tags (red). Text on it is always ink; use a tag colour to group, never to signal state.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: 'Available for work' dot and success text on bg and surface, always with a word beside it.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Form errors on bg and surface, always with a message.

families.display: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Display", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
families.text: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero name only, once per page.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: I build AI systems that ship.

styles.name: callout
styles.sample: Scores Canadian dog foods by what is in the bowl.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; nav lens inset.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Button vertical padding; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Glass panel padding (compact); card inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Glass panel padding (regular); grid gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on project cards.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between heading and section content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page side margin on desktop.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Vertical rhythm between page sections.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small thumbnails.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Glass panels, images inside cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Project cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Hero glass slab, large sheets.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, nav capsule and its lens. Concentric rule: an inner radius = outer radius minus the inset.

shadow.note: Glass is lit from above: a soft drop shadow plus two inner edges (light top, shade bottom).

tokens.name: shadow-glass
tokens.usage: Every floating glass element and solid card at rest: a hairline ring plus two soft layers.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Hovered cards and raised sheets.

tokens.name: shadow-rim
tokens.usage: Inner edge light on every glass element, layered under shadow-glass.

material.note: Backdrop filter strengths. Glass = backdrop-filter blur(x) saturate(glass-saturate).

tokens.name: blur-thin
tokens.usage: Chips and small controls over busy imagery.

tokens.name: blur-regular
tokens.usage: Nav capsule, buttons, captions.

tokens.name: blur-thick
tokens.usage: Panels carrying paragraphs of text; sheets.

tokens.name: glass-saturate
tokens.usage: Colour boost behind glass so screenshots and drawings stay vivid through it.

duration.note: Short and quiet. Under prefers-reduced-motion every animation becomes a fade of at most 150ms and springs jump to rest.

tokens.name: dur-press
tokens.usage: Card press dip.

tokens.name: dur-exit
tokens.usage: Anything leaving: filtered-out cards, closing toast, page swap out. Exits are faster than entrances.

tokens.name: dur-jelly
tokens.usage: Hover responses (card rise, arrow nudge, fills) and fade-ins of returning grid items.

tokens.name: dur-morph
tokens.usage: Things changing shape or place: nav lens, grid reflow, sheet opening from its button, toast arrival, nav compacting.

tokens.name: dur-enter
tokens.usage: First-screen entrance, scroll reveal, page swap in.

tokens.name: dur-stagger
tokens.usage: Delay between siblings in a scroll reveal (the hero entrance uses 70ms).

tokens.name: dur-toast
tokens.usage: How long a toast stays before floating away.

tokens.name: ease-jelly
tokens.usage: Overshoot curve, used sparingly: kept for consumers who need a CSS-only spring. The kit itself no longer uses it on hover.

tokens.name: ease-settle
tokens.usage: Calm arrival: reveals, entrances, fades, colour changes.

tokens.name: ease-press
tokens.usage: Reserved for press feedback in CSS-only contexts.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Leaving: accelerate out, never bounce out.

spring.note: Physical springs behind the interactive motion. Lucent reads these at runtime, so editing one retunes the motion everywhere. Kept well damped: one soft overshoot, no wobbling.

tokens.name: spring-jelly
tokens.usage: The soft press on buttons, chips, nav and segment items.

tokens.name: spring-lens
tokens.usage: Position of the liquid lens in NavBar and SegmentedControl; its speed drives the stretch.

tokens.name: spring-lens-width
tokens.usage: Width of the lens as it reshapes to the next item.

tokens.name: spring-knob
tokens.usage: Switch knob travel and the swell while held.

tokens.name: layer-nav
tokens.usage: Floating nav capsule.

tokens.name: layer-sheet
tokens.usage: Sheet and its backdrop.

tokens.name: layer-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts, above everything.
